items.name: AI/ML API
items.description: Official hosted MCP server with access to 10,000+ tools and models over Streamable HTTP. Server authentication: OAuth or Authorization: Bearer <API key> (https://aimlapi.com/app/keys). LoopForge does not provide an OAuth sign-in or key field for this entry; use a custom HTTP MCP configuration with an Authorization header for Bearer authentication. Model lookups and account checks are free; generation, chat, embeddings and tools_run are billed pay-as-you-go to your AI/ML API account.
